entries.en: An enemy has fallen asleep![n]Now's our chance to strike!

entries.en: The opponent is strong! Don't do[n]anything reckless!

entries.en: It looks vicious... We should go[n]directly for its weakness: Fire.

entries.en: It's powerful! You'll want fierce[n]Ice attacks!

entries.en: Its weakness is Electricity. If we[n]can use that, it'll go down fast!

entries.en: The enemy is strong! Defeat it[n]quickly with Bless attacks!

entries.en: They're tough, but weak to Nuclear.[n]You know what to do, right?
